remarks: FINAL & BEST BY TUESDAY 10/15 @ 5PM! Beautifully maintained 3 bedroom 2 bath Cape located in the desirable Glenbrook area. Meticulously updated - this home is designed to enhance daily living. Upon entry, you'll be greeted by a sun-filled living room with wood burning fireplace and gleaming hardwood floors. The dining room which also showcases hardwood floors hardwood floor with access to patio overlooking level, private yard, plenty of space to grow a garden and/or relax. Eat-in kitchen with granite counters and stainless steel appliances. The primary bedroom and full bathroom with tub and shower with glass enclosures to complete the main floor. Upstairs, two additional, spacious bedrooms, one opens to a terrace over the attached garage is great place for enjoying morning coffee. Full, two rooms partially finished basement can be used as a family room, office or bonus room with extra dry storage space plus laundry and mechanical area. One car attached garage and Central A/C. Easy access to I-95, and Glenbrook Train Station. Don't miss this opportunity to make this charming Cape Cod your new home!
